Two years ago, survivors of sexual harassment and violence lifted their voices to say #MeToo. 

Today, we are still listening. 

Today, we are still demanding more.

Sexual harassment is pervasive and affects all of us personally, professionally, and societally. But It wasn’t even until the mid-1970s that the term “sexual harassment” entered the public lexicon. #Metoo #sexualharassment https://t.co/4pN2NuYL3s

For those who have shared their experience of sexual harassment and assault with the hashtag #MeToo, sharing often provides relief and solidarity -- but it also takes a great emotional and financial toll. 📖 Read more: https://t.co/3Os4INl7FI
